c31_isolation: Whole-partition expansion produces only Cross or nonnullable equi joins with no JoinFilters; the extra C31 inlining stage returns before its local copy-stability guard. All inspected producer/copy/lowering code is byte-identical to pinned main.
runtime_invariant: Each upstream aggregate yields one row per selected window partition; MIN over that singleton must equal the value attached to the same row, regardless of its legal SUM reduction order.
confirmation_requires: An actual within-statement producer/window inconsistency, with row count/group/count and result types validated.

A separate review of the actual anonymous physical AST must bind the Double SUM update/state, source executions and both compared outputs to two independent producer evaluations. Stage-level marker counts provide candidate topology only; hash-bound dataflow evidence is mandatory.
No volatile/UDF/clock callable in the physical graph, with immutable generated input.
Matching revision, generator/schema/fixture hashes and row parameter across the candidate new record, same-case legacy record and new shared-producer control.
Explicit requested-mode configuration proof, disabled error fallback and successful exact-receipt binary provenance for every admitted record.

Legacy and shared controls satisfy the same invariant; the shared control has candidate multi-output topology plus a separate hash-bound actual AST dataflow review proving both compared outputs derive from one producer evaluation.
non_confirmation_cases: Copied producers whose outputs still agree.
Different floating SUM answers only across separate runs or requested modes.
A target error, a C31 guard rejection, missing plan proof, opaque grammar, stale generator or unmatched mode evidence.
initial_run_selection: cancellation_interleaved scalar copied in new and legacy modes
matching scalar shared case in new mode
exact_double scalar copied control in new mode
scope_limits: The conservative stage walker only detects candidate topology. It cannot establish the specific Double SUM state/input bindings or output provenance; actual anonymous AST dataflow review is explicitly required and unavailable so far.
Small deterministic workloads may use the same merge order on both copies; a consistent run does not prove the global policy safe.
Float/Decimal/Interval and representation-sensitive MIN/MAX have broader source concerns, but this probe isolates only finite Double SUM.
No generated query, input rows, raw plan, or result values are persisted.
source_independent_review_note: c41_review found the stage-level typed-reducer heuristic insufficient for confirmation; it is now labeled candidate topology and cannot satisfy assess_records without separate closed hash-bound dataflow attestations for copied and shared plans.
